items.t: Vertex Pharmaceuticals (VRTX) Stock May Be Undervalued After Its 187% Run
items.sum: Vertex Pharmaceuticals has delivered a powerful long haul return, yet the stock is now priced where only a closer look at its cash flows can show whether that level is sensible. With the market already rewarding the story, the open issue is how closely the current share price lines up with what the business is projected to generate in hard cash over time.
